guidetextdraw_1992685261._value:
1. You must appear in person at California State University, Fullerton (CSUF) to verify your identify as requested by the U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid Programs office.
  2. You must present a valid, government-issued photo identification (ID) that is current and not expired. Such as a passport or a driver’s license or other state-issued photo ID.
    • Office of Financial Aid at CSUF will maintain a copy of your photo ID annotated with the date the documentation was received and the name of the school official authorized to collect this identification.
  3. In addition to the verification of identity, the student is required to read and certify the Statement of Educational Purpose below:
